games.title: Happy Home in Robloxia
games.description: Happy Home in Robloxia is the iconic default starter place on Roblox used by new accounts between 2007 and 2012. Originally created in January 2007 for a building contest and uploaded to the official Roblox account in May 2007, the map served as a basic sandbox for new players to learn building and scripting.
